question: Should ClickClack make provider-scoped managed-channel reconciliation a supported permanent core API, rather than leaving integrations to compose the existing channel APIs?
rationale: This PR adds a new endpoint, SDK method, durable identity column, immutability rules, and migration behavior; patch correctness cannot establish the product boundary or long-term compatibility commitment.

options.title: Sponsor the core API
options.body: Accept provider-scoped reconciliation as a supported ClickClack contract, then require the contract correction and real upgrade/runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Keep composition external
options.body: Decline the new core identity and endpoint surface so integrations continue to use existing channel lifecycle APIs or a future external adapter.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core API
recommendation.body: Accept provider-scoped reconciliation as a supported ClickClack contract, then require the contract correction and real upgrade/runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the channel API, persisted schema, and SDK contract, but current-main ownership could not be proven from the available read-only inspection environment.
